Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog: Improved damage-over-time estimates and their contribution to player and ability totals. Corrected combo, secondary-target, and level-dependent calibration, plus buff timing at DoT confirmation. Added regression coverage for refreshes, pets, healing-only openers, and multi-player encounters. Existing performance improvements and content restrictions are unchanged.
